data.name: Not without my donuts
data.detailed_description:
“Incoming! Shoot them!” You scream over the flapping of bat wings and the buzzing of flies.

There are only two of you left in Cupcake World and you’re not leaving without your donuts. “Defend them or die of starvation!” Your voice quivers in fear as the words you shout aren’t sugar-coated and sound repulsive in a land that used to be filled with happy and friendly cupcakes. Hundred’s of your kind used to rejoice on the sugar high as they stacked donuts all day long . . . until, that fateful day when the hidden portal opened its mouth and the madness took over. Armies of sweet tooth obscenities flew in from the portal, while creepy, crawly spiders dropped down like paratroopers from the sky. All of your fellow cupcakes fled into the portal hoping to escape - only to never return.

“Get back,” Your voice rises in anguish! You shove a donut with a honey coated grin and a chocolate sparkle in its eyes between you and your comrade. He looks good with jelly dripping from his mouth, but you’ve no time to indulge in such sweet fantasies while being attacked from the skies!

You both stand ready to be champions. Your vows to protect your world and every remaining donut have toughened your resolve to overcome all obstacles. In the icing that sits on top of your flavored cupcake you some how understand how importantly the need to survive has become, as you glance at the donut you now defend, you realize, ‘Breakfast never tasted so delicious.’

“Get ready! Incoming! Fight on cupcake! Fight on!”

Jump right into the action with this arcade platformer shooter!

Inspired by the classic Super crate box,

- 3 Different scenarios

- 3 Different level difficulties

- Xbox360 controller & Keyboard support

- 2 Player Co-up gameplay

- Best scores for all levels

- 18 Unlockable Primairy weapons

- 12 Achievements + hidden

- 11 Secundairy Upgrades

- Donutshop to spend your donuts for upgrades

- Originial soundtrack written by David.F.Burrows

- Massive special effects

- Unlimited bugs ready to be shot to hell

- Narration and cupcake voiceover by Andrew Spooner (Actor/Puppeteer muppets)

- 3 vicious bosses

reviews.review:
Developed by Stake deep interactive and published by Ghost in the cartridge, Not without my donuts delivers an energetic arcade experience wrapped in a charmingly ridiculous premise. Rather than relying on a complex narrative, the game embraces lighthearted humor by placing players in the role of heroic cupcakes determined to defend their beloved donuts from an invasion of bizarre monsters that have emerged through an interdimensional portal. The candy-coated setting, quirky enemy designs, and tongue-in-cheek storytelling create an entertaining backdrop that immediately establishes the game's playful personality. It is a concept that knows exactly how absurd it is, and that confidence helps make the overall experience memorable from the very beginning.

At its heart, the game is a fast-paced twin-stick style arena shooter where survival depends on constant movement, quick decision-making, and efficient crowd control. Players are surrounded by increasingly aggressive waves of creatures that attack from every direction, forcing them to remain alert at all times. The objective extends beyond simply defeating enemies, as protecting the precious donuts becomes an equally important part of every battle. The straightforward gameplay mechanics make it easy to understand within minutes, but the escalating enemy numbers and increasing pressure ensure that later stages demand genuine skill and concentration.

One of the game's more creative mechanics revolves around its weapon system. Instead of permanently carrying a favorite weapon, players receive different armaments by collecting donuts scattered throughout the arena. This feature keeps every match unpredictable, encouraging adaptation instead of repetitive strategies. As players continue progressing, additional weapons become available through unlocks, providing a satisfying sense of advancement while rewarding repeated play sessions. Although the randomized weapon changes occasionally interrupt carefully planned tactics, they also contribute to the game's dynamic pace by constantly presenting new combat opportunities.

The colorful presentation is another standout feature. Vibrant environments, expressive character animations, and amusing monster designs create a visual style that feels cheerful despite the nonstop action. Every element, from the adorable cupcake protagonists to the oversized insects and strange creatures invading their world, reinforces the game's playful atmosphere. Explosions, projectiles, and visual effects remain easy to follow even during chaotic battles, allowing players to maintain awareness while enjoying the lively cartoon-inspired aesthetic. The soundtrack complements the action well with upbeat music that sustains the game's energetic rhythm, while sound effects provide satisfying feedback for every successful attack and defeated enemy.

Replayability is one of the strongest aspects of Not without my donuts. The gradual weapon unlock system, increasing difficulty, and pursuit of higher scores encourage players to return for additional sessions. Local cooperative multiplayer further enhances the experience by allowing two players to defend Cupcake World together, transforming the frantic battles into an enjoyable cooperative challenge. Working alongside another player introduces additional strategy and significantly increases the entertainment value, especially for those who enjoy classic couch co-op games that emphasize teamwork and shared excitement.

The game is not entirely free of flaws. Its arcade-focused design means content can feel somewhat limited once players have experienced every enemy type and unlocked the available arsenal. The randomized weapon mechanic, while refreshing, can occasionally produce frustrating moments when a less desirable weapon appears during a critical encounter. Difficulty also rises sharply during later waves, creating situations that may overwhelm newcomers before they have fully mastered the mechanics. These issues do not undermine the core gameplay, but they may reduce long-term appeal for players seeking a more expansive campaign or greater gameplay variety.

Despite these limitations, Not without my donuts succeeds by delivering exactly what it promises: a humorous, accessible, and entertaining arcade shooter built around a wonderfully unconventional concept. Its whimsical setting, polished presentation, satisfying action, and enjoyable cooperative mode combine to create an experience that captures the spirit of classic arcade gaming while introducing enough unique mechanics to stand apart from similar titles. Players looking for a colorful action game with quick sessions, replayable challenges, and plenty of personality will likely find this sugary adventure worth experiencing.

Rating: 5/10
